arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import subprocess, sys, tempfile
from limits import restrict_child
temp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
for sns in (False, True):
    try:
        p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-B','-u','-c','print(1)'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=temp, env=None, close_fds=True, start_new_session=sns, preexec_fn=restrict_child)
        print(sns, p.communicate())
    except Exception as e:
        print(sns, 'ERR', type(e).__name__, e)
"
